documentation_basis.s1_wrapper: E092-148-S1 is a tab-delimited file containing estimated population sizes for each glade for every year of occupation on Stegall, Mule, and Thorny Mountains.
documentation_basis.dryad_readme_location_schema: capture/recapture location is split into Column C = glade and Column D = section of glade; some glades were subdivided into sections while others were not; map files label glade number and sometimes section letter.
documentation_basis.zenodo_gps_methods: latitude and longitude of central glade positions were taken with a handheld Garmin GPS and downloaded directly from the device.
documentation_basis.published_unit_examples: founder populations are referred to as glades SM7, SM8, and SM9, whereas the GPS physical file contains suffixed waypoints such as SM7B, SM7F, SM7K, SM7L, SM7M, and SM7N.

analysis_node_rule.glade_id_rule: for every frozen Stegall GPS waypoint, analysis glade ID is the literal prefix SM plus the captured digit group; the optional trailing uppercase letters are treated only as the documented section label and are not separate glades

representative_coordinate_rule.method: unit-sphere mean of every GPS section-centre waypoint assigned to the same analysis glade, converted back to latitude/longitude
representative_coordinate_rule.reason: the public GPS source provides central positions for glades/sections but no separate whole-glade centroid for subdivided glades; the deterministic spherical mean preserves all response-independent section coordinates without selecting a section using outcome data
representative_coordinate_rule.claim_boundary: representative coordinates are not claimed to be official biological glade centroids and structural thresholds remain analyst-choice scales

structural_scale_rule.distance: great-circle haversine kilometres between frozen representative glade coordinates, Earth radius 6371.0088 km

pass_condition: coarse Stegall glade IDs are unique, all source waypoints parse under the frozen rule, node count clears the unchanged minimum 50, representative coordinates are finite/unique, and at least three positive structural thresholds are distinct
stop_condition: any failure stops before Individual_Glade_Sizes.txt access
